subject: Rock Mountain Cave
text: A treasure chest containing an Herb is found by going up from the entrance, heading right past the first staircase, and turning down at the intersection.

evidence.quote: Keep heading right until you hit an intersection where you can keep going right or go down. Go right and then down, get the Herb from the treasure chest, and then go back to the intersection, down, and to the staircase.

subject: Rock Mountain Cave
text: A treasure chest containing 17 gold is found on the lower level by heading down at the first intersection.

evidence.quote: Take the staircase down. Now, go right and to an intersection, you can go up, down, or keep going right. Go down, and grab the treasure chest with 17 gold in it, and then shoot up until you hit a wall and can either go left or right.

subject: Rock Mountain Cave
text: A treasure chest containing a Torch is located down the third path on the lower level.

evidence.quote: Go right, skipping the first two paths going down. On the third path going down, take it, and get the two treasure chests. One has a torch in it, the other has the Fighter's Ring.

subject: Rock Mountain Cave
text: The Fighter's Ring is found in a treasure chest down the third path on the lower level.

evidence.quote: On the third path going down, take it, and get the two treasure chests. One has a torch in it, the other has the Fighter's Ring.

subject: Fighter's Ring
text: Equipping the Fighter's Ring grants a +2 bonus to both speed and strength, but cannot be removed once equipped.

evidence.quote: Go to Items, and equip the Fighter's Ring to gain small bonuses in speed and strength (+2 each). You can't take off the ring after you equip it, but that's okay, doesn't really matter.

subject: Rock Mountain Cave
text: A chest containing 112 gold is located south and around from the Fighter's Ring chest.

evidence.quote: Now head south and around, and then back up to another chest, and get what's inside of it, 112 gold.

subject: Rock Mountain Cave
text: All treasure chests in Rock Mountain Cave reappear after leaving the cave.

evidence.quote: Remember all of these chests reappear after you leave so you can keep coming back to get what you want.

subject: Rock Mountain Cave
text: The top level of Rock Mountain Cave contains Druids, Druins, Drakeemas, and Warlocks.

evidence.quote: When you do decide to level up, after getting all healed, come back to the Rock Mountain Cave and roam around on the top level, you'll fight some Druids, Druins, Drakeemas and Warlocks, and whatnot.

subject: Village of Kol
text: Full Plate can be purchased in the Village of Kol for 3,000 gold.

evidence.quote: Once you hit 3,000 gold (and I'm sure you'll be leaving often to heal and save), go back to the Village of Kol, purchase the Full Plate, sell off your Half Plate, heal, and save.

subject: Swamp Cave
text: The recommended starting level for passing through Swamp Cave is level 10 or 11.

evidence.quote: SUGGESTED LEVEL – You'll start out on level 10 or 11 (I was at level 11), and we're just shooting right through here, so no level change.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Swamp Cave holds the captive Princess Gwaelin, guarded by the Green Dragon.

evidence.quote: Okay, the Swamp Cave is the cave that holds Princess Gwaelin. But hold your horses! Although our levels are sufficient, we aren't strong enough to fight the guardian that guards her yet, the Green Dragon.

subject: Swamp Cave
text: To pass through Swamp Cave to the other continent, cast Radiant, head directly south around the intrusion, and take the stairs in the block area.

evidence.quote: Simply walk into the cave, cast Radiant, and shoot down south, a straight shot (not turning into ANY paths, you might run into the Green Dragon, and that'd be the end of you.), just go south, and go around the intrusion, go into the block area where the stairs is, and leave the cave.

subject: Rimuldar
text: From the south exit of Swamp Cave, Rimuldar is reached by travelling west and south along the mountains, then east inside the mountain barrier to the island town.

evidence.quote: Once outside, go west and then south, following the mountains, then go east and inside the mountain barrier. From there you should see the town, it sits on an island, with a desert-like path leading to it. Enter the town of Rimuldar.

subject: Inn
text: The inn in Rimuldar costs 55 gold.

evidence.quote: INN – 55 gold

subject: Weapons and Armor Shop
text: The Copper Sword is sold in Rimuldar for 180 gold.

evidence.quote: SHOPS - *Weapons and Armor*...Copper Sword – 180 gold

subject: Weapons and Armor Shop
text: The Hand Axe is sold in Rimuldar for 560 gold.

evidence.quote: SHOPS - *Weapons and Armor*...Hand Axe – 560 gold

subject: Weapons and Armor Shop
text: The Broad Sword is sold in Rimuldar for 1500 gold.

evidence.quote: SHOPS - *Weapons and Armor*...Broad Sword – 1500 gold

subject: Weapons and Armor Shop
text: Half Plate armor is sold in Rimuldar for 1000 gold.

evidence.quote: SHOPS - *Weapons and Armor*...Half Plate – 1000 gold

subject: Weapons and Armor Shop
text: Full Plate armor is sold in Rimuldar for 3000 gold.

evidence.quote: SHOPS - *Weapons and Armor*...Full Plate – 3000 gold

subject: Weapons and Armor Shop
text: Magic Armor is sold in Rimuldar for 7700 gold.

evidence.quote: SHOPS - *Weapons and Armor*...Magic Armor – 7700 gold

subject: Tools Shop
text: Magic Keys are sold in Rimuldar for 53 gold.

evidence.quote:
*Tools*
        Magic Key – 53 gold

subject: Orwick
text: A blue-haired man named Orwick is waiting along the river before crossing into the town of Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Before crossing the bridge, go up, hugging the river as you go. Talk to the blue-haired man you come across, and he'll say, "I am Orwick, and I am waiting for my girlfriend."

subject: Red Knight
text: A red knight walking in Rimuldar's weapon shop states that the Dragonlord's scales are as hard as steel.

evidence.quote: Talk to the red knight walking around in there and he'll say, "The scales of the Dragonlord are as hard as steel."

subject: Old Man
text: An old man on an island area in Rimuldar reveals that Erdrick created a rainbow over the western part of the island and entered the darkness from a hidden entrance in the Dragonlord's room.

evidence.quote: Now, circle around going left, and talk to the old man on the island-like area. He'll say, "Over the western part of this island, Erdrick created a rainbow. 'Tis also said that he entered the darkness from a hidden entrance in the room of the Dragonlord."

subject: Guard
text: A guard in Rimuldar advises that the Stones of Sunlight are located in Tantegel Castle.

evidence.quote: Talk to the Guard and he'll say, "Thou shalt find the Stones of Sunlight in Tantegel Castle is thou has not found them yet."

subject: Old Man
text: An old man behind a desk in the southern building states that sun and rain meet in a magic temple to the south.

evidence.quote: The old man behind the desk says, "This is a magic place. Hast thou found a magic temple? If you answer "yes" he says, "In this temple do sun and rain meet." If you say "no" he says, "Go to the south."

subject: Rimuldar
text: Wings can be found in a treasure chest behind the locked doors at the Rimuldar Inn.

evidence.quote: Go to the Inn and unlock the two doors there with them. Now you'll want to get the Wings in the Treasure Chest (use them to get back to the Castle anytime) and talk to the old man, who'll say, "Good day, I am Howard. Four steps south of the bath in Kol thou shalt find a magic item."

subject: Goldman
text: Defeating a Goldman outside Rimuldar awards 200 gold and 6 experience points.

evidence.quote: While Goldmen give you 200 gold, they give you 6 experience points. Stick fighting Wyverns, Metal Scorpions, et cetera.

subject: Rimuldar
text: The recommended leveling goal outside Rimuldar is to reach at least level 12 or 13 and accumulate around 8000 gold for Magic Armor and five Magic Keys.

evidence.quote: SUGGESTED LEVEL – Start on level 11, you should at end at at least level 12, maybe even 13....Level up outside of Rimuldar, the goal is 7700 gold, but you should also invest in five Magic Keys as well, so make it more around 8000.

subject: Magic Armor
text: Equipping Magic Armor automatically restores 1 Hit Point every few steps.

evidence.quote: With the Magic Armor equipped, you'll start automatically healing yourself so that shouldn't be a problem. (1 Hit Point every few steps).

subject: Swamp Cave
text: From the south entrance of Swamp Cave, the Green Dragon is reached by walking straight north to the northern entrance, then going right, down along the wall, left, and through a door.

evidence.quote: From the south entrance of the cave, go straight north until you hit the northern entrance of the cave, then go right, and down, hugging the right hand wall. Once you hit a barrier, go left a bit and through the door. You'll run into the Green Dragon.

subject: Green Dragon
text: The Green Dragon can be defeated by attacking continuously with the Broadsword and healing, or alternately putting him to sleep, healing, and attacking.

evidence.quote: The trick with the Green Dragon is not to put him to sleep, just constantly hit him up with your Broadsword, and keep yourself healed. If you find yourself in trouble, run away, regroup (you can go north to Kol or south to Rimuldar to heal) and then try again. Or you can put him to sleep, heal, attack, repeat.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: After defeating the Green Dragon, use a Magic Key on the door to speak with Princess Gwaelin and agree to escort her to Tantegel Castle.

evidence.quote: Either way, once he perishes, go behind where he was, use one of your Magic Keys on the door, and talk to the captive princess. She'll say, "Thou art brave indeed to rescue me, [You]. I am Gwaelin, Daughter of Lorik. Will thou take me to the castle?" If you answer "no" she'll say, "But thou must." So say "yes" and it'll say Princess Gwaelin embraces thee.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Returning Princess Gwaelin to King Lorik in the throne room completes the rescue and rewards the player with Gwaelin's Love.

evidence.quote: Once in the castle, go to the throne room and talk to the King. He'll say, "Forever shall I be grateful for the gift of my daughter returned to her home, [You]. Accept my thanks. Now Gwaelin, come to my side." Then it says that Gwaelin whispers to her father, "Wait a moment, please. I would like to give a present to [You]. Please accept my love, QuickMan..." You get Gwaelin's Love out of this

subject: Gwaelin's Love
text: Using Gwaelin's Love displays your current coordinates on the world map and tells you how many experience points are required to reach the next level.

evidence.quote: You get Gwaelin's Love out of this, which allows you to see your current position in the worldmap and she'll tell you how many experience points you need to go up another level.

subject: Magic Key Merchant
text: Magic Keys can be purchased in Tantegel Castle behind a locked door for 85 gold from the merchant.

evidence.quote: Open the door near him, and go buy some more Magic Keys for 85 gold from the fat merchant behind the desk.

subject: Damage Floor
text: Walking on the barrier floor in Tantegel Castle damages the player for 25 hit points per step.

evidence.quote: Cross the floor (lose 25 hit points each step) and talk to the Red Knight, who says, "In Garinham, look for the grave of Garin. Thou must push on a wall of darkness there."

subject: Red Knight
text: A Red Knight past the barrier floor in Tantegel Castle reveals that you must push on a wall of darkness at the grave of Garin in Garinham.

evidence.quote: Cross the floor (lose 25 hit points each step) and talk to the Red Knight, who says, "In Garinham, look for the grave of Garin. Thou must push on a wall of darkness there."

subject: Tantegel Castle
text: Four treasure chests containing small quantities of gold are found in a locked room guarded by a guard.

evidence.quote: Circle back around to that locked door, behind which is a guard and four treasure chests. Although the guard says "Never does a brave man steal," take what's in the chests anyway. All that's in the chests is some small quantities of gold, but take it anyway.

subject: Garinham
text: A treasure chest inside the large building in Garinham contains an Herb.

evidence.quote: The fat green man by the treasure chests says, "I suggest making a map if thy path leads into the darkness." No thanks buddy. =) Then proceed to open his treasure chests to find an Herb, a Torch, and a small amount of gold.

subject: Garinham
text: A treasure chest inside the large building in Garinham contains a Torch.

evidence.quote: Then proceed to open his treasure chests to find an Herb, a Torch, and a small amount of gold.

subject: Garinham
text: A treasure chest inside the large building in Garinham contains a small amount of gold.

evidence.quote: Then proceed to open his treasure chests to find an Herb, a Torch, and a small amount of gold.

subject: Garin's Grave
text: Walking three steps from the left of the top of the large building and pressing up leads through the wall to the area behind the building leading to Garin's grave.

evidence.quote: Go three steps from the top of the building from the left and press up. You'll go through the wall to an area behind the building. Go right, talk to the old man, and he'll say, "The harp attracts enemies. Stay away from the grave in Garinham." Cross the bridge, and go down the stairs to his right.
